newsitem.title: USA: New Haven mayor to head Conn. cities group.
newsitem.headline: New Haven mayor to head Conn. cities group.

text.p: New Haven Mayor John DeStefano, Jr., a strong advocate of property tax reform, was elected Thursday as president of the Connecticut Conference of Municipalities, the state association of cities and towns.
DeStefano, a Democrat, said he hoped to see more progress on property tax reform and more equitable education funding.
DeStefano also said he would push for greater equity to towns and cities through the program of state payment-in-lieu of taxes on tax-exempt property.
He said this would increase the percentage of lost local property taxes above the current 20 percent for state property and 60 percent for colleges and hospitals.
The Connecticut Conference of Municipalities has 143 members, who represent 91 percent of the state's population.
The group represents municipalities in the state legislature, and before the state executive branch, regulatory agencies and the courts.
